name: Sahalee Country Club
centre_source: Wikipedia infobox 47°38′06″N 122°03′25″W (the club); Stymie's map link 47.635136, -122.055192 agrees within 150 m. Not checked against OSM.
par_note: par 36 on each of three nines; any two make a par-72 18. Championship course = South + North.
architects: Rees Jones (1996-98 renovation; 2022-23 master-plan renovation with Steve Weisser)
renovations: 1969-70: East and South (the first 18) opened 9 Aug 1969; North opened July 1970 (HistoryLink)
1996-98: Rees Jones redesigned bunkers and key features of North and South for the 1998 PGA; East after the PGA
2000: driving range rebuilt (target greens, bunkers, drainage)
2015: Rees Jones tree management plan, tree removal ongoing since

fall 2022 - Feb 2023: Rees Jones / Steve Weisser master plan, built by Landscapes Unlimited: every bunker redesigned (some removed, added or moved), drainage and irrigation, fairway landing areas and approaches widened, trees removed (championship 8, 11, 12, 16) and canopies raised, the pond by the championship 10th (North 1) green extended to its front left and a front-left bunker removed
notable: Golf Digest: Second 100 Greatest 196th (2025-26), 4th in Washington; 100 Greatest 1977-2014 and 2017-18, best 48th (1989-90)
video_games: Not checked (scouting's web-search budget ran out). From memory, unverified: probably Sierra's PGA Championship Golf 1999 Edition (the 1998 PGA venue).
tees_note: yards = South/North (championship); _ne = North/East; _es = East/South. Club website ratings (one set for every pair). Green is called Silver on the club's overview page.
water: Six ponds (club: 6 water hazards): South 2 (lake to carry on the second shot), South 5 (lake right of the green), South 9 (lake curving round the left), North 1 / championship 10th (horseshoe pond round the green, extended in 2022-23), North 8 (water right of the green), East 1 (lake guarding the approach). All red by default.
